Additional circuit explanations:
During deployment, the contract takes four private data points, hashes them, and stores the result in pub_alias. The SCCC (State Central Collection Centre) Director is the data owner for the interlinks between case details and evidence details and the evidence package pub alias. The pub_alias serves as the identifier for evidence packages during their transit between 18 different RFSL labs.
When the contract is deployed, we use private data (evidence) and hash it to derive a value for pub_alias. This function takes four pieces of private evidence and case details, which are stored local and private by the SCCC and retrieved using a witness call.
